round1.model1: Supervised Random Forest on 25 labeled occupations with CV/test metrics.
round1.model2: KMeans youth grouping on tract-level features and weighted career matching.
known_issues: Missing mobility values in tract data before imputation approach.
Small occupation sample (25 jobs) limits production coverage.
No holdout-state validation in this round.
College affordability integration limited in Round 1.

round2.model1: Rule-based interpretable risk scoring over full O*NET occupation set (risk_score 0-4 + risk_label).
round2.model2: KNN-imputed tract mobility + KMeans youth groups + recommendation engine with group-specific weights.
limitations: Education outcomes use tract/state-level aggregated fields, not school-level recommendations.
No supervised accuracy metric for rule-based Round 2 by design.
